Author: Akari
Name: Consolidator
Description: Consolidates gil and items from your alt characters onto a single main, and hands items back out from that main to the alts. The alt side logs in, travels via Lifestream, walks to the receiver with vnavmesh, trades over everything above your floors, and returns to the FC. Requires AutoRetainer, Lifestream and vnavmesh; the receiving character can accept trades with Consolidator itself or Dropbox.
Punchline: Sweep gil from every alt onto one character.
